mostWorthwhile.text: Attaching the biceps and triceps was most worthwhile because the poses connected their pulls to bending and straightening the elbow.

leastWorthwhile.text: Building the triceps felt a little repetitive after building the biceps, although the second muscle was needed.

surprise.text: Seeing that both muscles pull, rather than one pushing the arm back, changed how I understood the opposing movements.

arbitrary.text: No action felt especially arbitrary; the pictures and empty slot gave the combinations a purpose, though most choices were already provided.
